records.note: Totals cover the league phase and the knockouts, so a club that went far has played more matches. That is why defence is measured per match rather than by total — otherwise going out early would look like a record. Penalty shootouts do not count as goals.

players.assistsScope: Scope limited by the source: it ranks by goals, so a player without goals never appears no matter how many assists they provide; and it reports no assist figure at all for 32 of the 100 players, who are left out of this table.
